trigger: The repaired TSMOM-ALPHA-0029 run downloaded funding histories for all 549 active symbols with zero download errors, then stopped before PNL because 302 active symbol-days had no recorded funding settlement event. Examples include a long BNXUSDT gap around the old-contract lifecycle and one ALPHAUSDT date near its contract-end period.
principle: Funding is an event cashflow, not a daily return that is guaranteed to contain an observation on every active calendar day. Canonical accounting applies only official recorded settlement events and never manufactures a rate for an absent event.

accounting_rule.source: official Binance Public Data USD-M monthly fundingRate archive
accounting_rule.event_timing: target t becomes effective t+1 00:00:01; exact 00:00 event is charged to the previous held day; later events use the current held day
accounting_rule.active_day_without_recorded_event: zero funding cashflow for that symbol-day because no official settlement event is present; retain as an explicit coverage diagnostic, not an imputed zero-rate observation
accounting_rule.missing_archive_file_or_download_failure: hard failure; never treated as zero cashflow
accounting_rule.price_tradability: separate hard gate remains: any held position without an official next-day perp price return is invalid and stops the run

required_diagnostics: active symbol-days with at least one recorded funding event
active symbol-days without a recorded event
long and short gross exposure on no-event days
recorded-event funding contribution split between long and short
prohibited: no forward fill or interpolation of funding rates
no removal of a contract from historical eligibility merely because a later funding gap is observed
no change to TSMOM signal, universe thresholds, costs, gross, qualification gates or asset weights
interpretation_limit: If no-event coverage is economically material, the strategy cannot be promoted from this dataset alone; the coverage uncertainty must be carried into the result and forward evidence.
